what_happened: Dispatch's grep pattern (*implementation-agent.md) does not match the 3 hard-mode implementation agents (cslib-implementation-hard-agent.md, lean-implementation-hard-agent.md, books-implementation-hard-agent.md), which also have zero mentions of modified_files -- the same bug, outside the literally-named scope. Flagged in the research report (Finding 1 scope note, Recommendation 7) for the plan to decide whether to fold in.

Research report identified an existing in-repo propagation mechanism (canonical fragment + lint-agent-contracts.sh Check C/G/H pattern) plus the exact next free check letter, so plan construction was mechanical rather than exploratory.

The dispatch's SCOPE glob (*implementation-agent.md) structurally cannot match *-implementation-hard-agent.md, so three hard-mode agents with the identical defect were never counted; plan deliberately widens scope from 10 to 13 agents and isolates the widening in its own phase.

The track-on-write canonical line was inserted word-wrapped across 3-4 physical lines in all 13 Phase 2-4 agent files for readability. Phase 2-4's own grep -cF verification used a truncated anchor substring that only spanned the first wrapped line, so it reported 1 match and passed even though the full canonical line never appeared as a single physical line. This was only caught when Check L's own runtime grep -F extraction of the full line from the fragment failed to match any of the 13 files in Phase 5. Fixed by collapsing the track-on-write line to a single physical line in all 13 files before finishing Check L.

Phase 6's full verify-deploy.sh run reported 3 of 36 checks failed: doc-lint (gate 3) deployed-script-content-drift and line_count-mismatch findings for scripts/tests/test-git-commit-scoped.sh and context/standards/git-staging-scope.md, the identical two files surfaced again by gate 5 (manifest-driven verify.lua), plus a gate 10 (validate-state.sh --deep) 30s timeout. git log/git status confirm both drifted files are sibling task 394's own declared file_scope and in-flight concurrent edits (test-git-commit-scoped.sh last committed as 'task 394 phase 3', git-staging-scope.md currently uncommitted-modified) -- not task 393's work. Gate 10's timeout is an unrelated environmental/concurrency flake against the shared specs/state.json, also outside task 393's file scope. Triaged per Phase 6's instructions and reported here rather than fixed.

Per this plan's own Non-Goals, several of the thirteen in-scope agents' per-phase commit blocks (e.g. z3-implementation-agent.md's Stage 4D) build stage_paths from the task directory, specs/TODO.md, and specs/state.json only -- never the source files the phase just touched, unlike general-implementation-agent.md's mechanized git-commit-phase.sh path. This is a distinct staging defect in the same files, deliberately left unfixed here per the plan's Non-Goals, and recorded for its own future task.

Task 393's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
